title: Raisina Young Fellows Programme 2027 (PCNS places)
overview: The Policy Center for the New South (PCNS), Morocco, has allocated two fully funded places for participation in the Raisina Young Fellows Programme 2027, held in New Delhi, India, from 11 to 20 March 2027. The programme convenes emerging leaders from around the world to discuss political, economic and social issues with a focus on Asia, and inducts them as Raisina Young Fellows at the Raisina Dialogue.
eligibility: Demonstrate outstanding achievements and proven leadership
Work in politics, diplomacy, business, media, civil society, or academia
Be available for the full duration of the program
Show the capacity and readiness to contribute to international forums
funding_details: PCNS 'has allocated two fully funded places'
Selected participants receive: a comprehensive fellows' program; roundtrip economy airfare; accommodation, meals, and in-country transportation
Visa and insurance costs are not mentioned

sources.label: PCNS: Call for Applications, Raisina Young Fellows Programme 2027

eligibility_reason: Two facts decide it. The minimum age is 28 and the profile records only 'under 30'. The version of this call read on 26 October (now removed from its old address) reserved the places for members of the PCNS youth community and the profile records no such membership; the current page does not mention membership. 'Outstanding achievements and proven leadership' and English proficiency are also not recorded.
potential_issues: The earlier version of this call (read on 26 October at an address that now returns 404) said the places were reserved for PCNS youth community members; the current page states no membership condition. Which rule applies is unconfirmed
Only two places, allocated by PCNS; ORF's own open call was not found
Minimum age 28
Deadline 2 November 2026, 5:00 pm Casablanca time
Visa for India and insurance not mentioned
action: If you are 28 or older and can show leadership achievements in politics, diplomacy, business, media, civil society or academia, complete the PCNS application form by Monday 2 November 2026, 5:00 pm Casablanca time. Before spending time on it, check whether PCNS still limits the places to its youth community.
notes: Part of the strategic partnership between PCNS, ORF and the Italian Institute for International Political Studies (ISPI), through which each institution nominates people for the others' programmes. 29 October 2026: the former page (pcns-youth-community-call-applications-raisina-young-fellows-programme-2027) returns 404 and the call now sits at the address above; the application form link is unchanged.
relevance_reason: A fully funded policy programme in India matches the policy-analysis interest, but access is narrow: only two places, a minimum age of 28 and senior-sounding achievement criteria.
